integration.description: Connect GitLab Cloud or self-hosted instances with a personal access token.

pat.label: Personal Access Token
pat.instructions: Enter your GitLab instance URL (for example, https://gitlab.com or your self-hosted URL) and a personal access token. Create a token under User settings → Access tokens on GitLab.com, or {your-instance}/-/user_settings/personal_access_tokens on self-hosted GitLab. Include at least the api scope.

connect.instructions: Enter your GitLab instance URL (for example, https://gitlab.com or your self-hosted URL) and a personal access token. Create a token under User settings → Access tokens on GitLab.com, or {your-instance}/-/user_settings/personal_access_tokens on self-hosted GitLab. Include at least the api scope.

gitlab.section-description: Connect GitLab for source control and sync.
gitlab.connection-description: Enter your GitLab instance URL and sign in with a personal access token.
